audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart read Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante, which disagrees with the already-audited mirror on four rows and hands K'Sante the two late rows the mirror gives Zac.
audit.why: The mirror (audits/top/zac__ksante) settled on K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Zac. Level 1 is K'Sante's because Ntofo Strikes returns every 3.5s while Stretching Strikes is a 14s grab; the late rows are Zac's because Unstable Matter is percent max health and Cell Division revives him.
audit.corrected: Chart set to K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Zac, matching the mirror exactly, with the level-1 why rewritten so it no longer says 'neither of you can punish'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named no Zac ability and carried no cooldowns — the packet flags exactly that.
audit.why: Stretching Strikes 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s at 800 range, Unstable Matter 5s flat at 350, Elastic Slingshot 21/18/15/12/9s, Let's Bounce! 120/105/90s. Elastic Slingshot's 21s at rank 1 is the punish window the page was gesturing at without a number.
audit.corrected: All four spikes now carry names and real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text says 'Q3 knock-up-pull' in four places — K'Sante's 2-stack Ntofo Strikes only pulls; the knock-back and stun are Path Maker (W). Unstable Matter's percent-max-health damage was described as generic chip, and the page told a tank to answer it with armour.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.' Riot's Unstable Matter text: 'dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage', and the missing-interactions file flags both the resistances-invalidated and needs-antiheal rules here.
audit.corrected: W stuns, Q pulls; Unstable Matter is now named as percent max health, and Grievous Wounds is tied to the level-6 all-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file's derived flags list 'grounding' on Elastic Slingshot (E).
audit.why: Riot's text for Elastic Slingshot is 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — a self-dash with a knockup on landing. Nothing in it grounds anyone; the flag looks like it was parsed off the word 'ground'.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim was written into the page. Flagged here so nobody later 'restores' it.

edits.before: Level 1 is a non-event — you only have Q and Zac only has one ability, so just farm and don't step into E sling range where he can tag you and start a passive-blob trade. The lane opens up at Level 3 when your Q-W combo comes online: if he slings in or walks up to last-hit, W the committed Zac, then Q3 to knock-up and pull him in. The catch is his passive — he drops healthy blobs you must walk over to deny, or every trade you win gets sustained back.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours in small doses — Ntofo Strikes is up every 3.5 seconds and his only ability, Stretching Strikes, is a 14-second grab, so chip him at 450 and deny the blobs. The lane opens at Level 3 when Q-W comes online: if he slings in or walks up to last-hit, W-stun the committed Zac, then pull him back with the 2-stack Ntofo. Watch his auto wind-up — Stretching Strikes resets it. Keep stepping on blobs, or every trade you win gets healed back.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak: you out-position his short E sling, bank small leads with your bulk, and trade around his Q/W CC. Bait the sling and his crowd control, then commit your W-Q3 when they're down and he can't re-engage. At 6, All Out is a genuine coinflip — it can win the duel against a Zac with no blobs up, but it strips your tankiness, so only ult when his CC is spent and he can't slink away to a blob pile and heal.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak: you out-position Elastic Slingshot, 21 seconds at rank 1, bank small leads with your bulk, and trade around Unstable Matter's 5s. Bait the sling, then commit W and the Ntofo pull while it is down and he cannot re-engage. At 6, All Out is a genuine coinflip — it beats a Zac with no blobs up, but it strips your bulk, so ult only with Grievous Wounds bought and no blob pile behind him to heal on.

edits.before: This is where Zac reclaims it. At 2+ items he out-sustains your armor shred, his blob revive means a kill you earned just stands back up, and his E sling makes him a better teamfight engager than you are a dueler. Don't bet on solo-killing him late — your value is using R All Out to recall his sling engage off your carry and peel him out of the fight. Close on your Level 3-5 windows; the longer it goes, the more his sustain and pick threat outscale your lockdown.
edits.after: This is where Zac reclaims it. At 2+ items Unstable Matter takes a percentage of your max health every 5 seconds, so stacking armour is the wrong answer, and the Cell Division revive means a kill you earned stands back up. Don't bet on solo-killing him late — your value is R, launching his sling engage off your carry and out of the fight. Close on your Level 1-5 windows; the longer it goes, the more his sustain and pick threat outscale your lockdown.

edits.after: Hit Level 3, W-stun a committed Zac, then Ntofo-pull him before the blobs sustain the trade back
